title: Oversized Oven Roasted Australian Rhubarb Tart
description: A sour and indulgent Australian dessert featuring forced rhubarb, this oversized tart is perfect for special occasions. The combination of roasted rhubarb and flaky pastry is a true delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the melted butter, egg, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a large tagliere and trim the edges to fit.
In a separate bowl, mix together the cut rhubarb and granulated sugar.
Arrange the rhubarb mixture on one half of the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the dough over the rhubarb mixture to form a triangle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the water and press to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top of the tart to allow steam to escape.
Bake the tart in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
